title: Markdown
description: This mod adds markdown to minecraft !
body:
# This mod adds markdown features to minecraft !

![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/I27Gveqs/images/4c4aa1035e89c44de1e7fb44133a08222c1a3af4.png)

## Features:

- Gifs
> Any URL from specific domain names (e.g. discord media and tenor media) will turn into a clickable gif which when click will render in chat.

![Gifs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/I27Gveqs/images/d5ac59fe6298fc102dbae8139de5c83ee533a390_350.webp)

- URLs
> Any URL sent will automatically be clickable

![URLs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/I27Gveqs/images/5229d6c3206551f126dba485bfd7fa8bde29f229_350.webp)

- Bold text
> Can be done by doing \** (asterisk) before and \** after
- Italic text
> Can be done by doing \* (asterisk) before and \* after
- Obfuscated text
> Can be done by doing \|| (double vertical line) before and \|| after
- Strikethrough text
> Can be done by doing \~~ (double tilde) before and \~~ after
- Underscore text
> Can be done by doing \__ (double underscore) before and \__ after

![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/I27Gveqs/images/b6301d333843aa439400e95587e1c6e5184db387.png)
